# `aitbc explorer network-stats`

Get network-wide statistics for a chain.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc explorer network-stats [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Chain ID to query |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc explorer network-stats
```
